title: Pseudo-Traveling Waves and Bumps in Quantum and Classical Hierarchical Cellular Neural Networks
summary: We study the existence of pseudo-traveling waves and bump solutions for two classes of hierarchical cellular neural networks (CNNs) defined over the ring of $p$-adic integers $\mathbb{Z}_{p}$. The first type is a $p$-adic CNN described by a reaction-diffusion equation, while the second type is its quantum analog obtained via Wick rotation. The $p$-adic CNNs are hierarchical versions of the classical Chua-Yang CNNs; these networks have a tree-like hierarchical architecture with infinitely many cells and hidden layers.
